topPRs.title: fix(os-linux): restore vendored Tails debian/changelog dropped by the .gitignore rewrite
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
## Problem (ISO build layer 7)

With layers 1-6 fixed (arch gate, ERR trap, setup-bun, branding, source + dist overlay patches — #15223/#15226/#15232/#15250/#15285), the re-dispatched **Build elizaOS Linux ISO** run cleared the overlay-prep step and reached `just build` -> `build.sh` -> `build-iso.sh`, where it failed on **both arches**:

```
no .git in source tree — initializing a throwaway repo for the build
dpkg-parsechangelog: error: cannot open file debian/changelog: No such file or directory
error: Recipe `build` failed on line 154 with exit code 25
```

## Root cause

`packages/os/linux/tails/debian/changelog` is a **required vendored-Tails source input**, not a build artifact:

- `build-iso.sh` seeds the previous-release git tag from it (`dpkg-parsechangelog --offset 1`) when building from the tag-less vendored snapshot;
- `tails/auto/config` copies it into the ISO docs (`cp debian/changelog .../doc/tails/Changelog`);
- `tails/Changelog` is a **symlink** to it (dangling without it);
- it matches the pinned **Tails 7.8** snapshot the rest of `tails/` is cut from.

It was committed in the elizaOS baseline, but the wholesale `.gitignore` regenerated by the develop history rewrite (#14459) added a `/packages/os/linux/tails/debian/changelog` line — lumping this required source in with the large generated/binary files that auto-generated rule-list drops (PDFs, PNGs, CSVs). So a fresh CI checkout no longer contains it. `tails/` is not a submodule and **no generator or fetch step exists** anywhere — the file is simply meant to be present.

## Fix

Restore the exact file from the baseline blob and drop the erroneous ignore rule.

## Validation

Locally, the exact failing call now succeeds against the restored file:

```
$ cd packages/os/linux/tails
$ dpkg-parsechangelog -SVersion               # current
7.8
$ dpkg-parsechangelog --offset 1 --count 1 -SVersion | tr '~' '-'   # the failing call
7.7.2
```

The `tails/Changelog` symlink resolves and the `auto/config` cp source exists. Full ~1.5h ISO assembly re-dispatched on develop after merge (amd64 required; arm64 continue-on-error).

## Heads-up (not fixed here, likely future layers)

The same `.gitignore` rewrite also dropped several `tails/wiki` **media/font assets** (`*.mp4`, `*.ttf`, `.png` under `wiki/src/lib` and `wiki/src/install/inc`). Those are website/wiki build inputs and may surface as a later ikiwiki-website layer if the release build doesn't skip the site. Flagging for owner awareness rather than speculatively re-committing binaries.

topPRs.title: test(ui): fix test:suggestions-e2e — align fixture to #14678 precheck + #14873 voice gate
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
## Problem

`test:suggestions-e2e` (UI Fixture E2E workflow) fails **7 assertions** on `develop`. The fixture (`packages/ui/src/components/pages/__e2e__/run-suggestions-e2e.mjs`) drives the **real** proactive-interaction server pipeline (routes → decider → gate → `routeAutonomyTextToUser` → broadcast) with a scripted small-model. Two merged production changes moved the delivery/governance contract out from under the fixture's scripted model + observed gate. **No production regression** — the fixture was testing the old contract.

## Root cause (per assertion)

### 1. Humanness voice gate (#14873)
`routeAutonomyTextToUser` now runs every admitted proactive comment through `ensureAgentVoice` — a **second** `runtime.useModel(TEXT_SMALL)` rephrase pass — before broadcast. The fixture's scripted `useModel` counted that voice call as a judge call and returned the **next scripted judge output** as the "voiced" text, so the broadcast frame carried raw judge JSON for the *next* interaction instead of the parsed comment.

- Broke: `s1: reached the judge` (judgeCalls inflated 1→2 per delivery), `s1`/`s6: governed frame` and phase-2 `the bubble shows the governed comment text` (frame text was raw JSON, e.g. `{"comment":"Here is a calendar tip."...}`).
- Fix: `useModel` branches on the voice-gate prompt cue (`Rewritten message:`) and returns the handed text **verbatim** — a faithful no-op voicing honoring the gate's own "preserve every exact value" contract — tallied as `voiceCalls`. Added `s1`/`s6` `voiceCalls` assertions so #14873 is now positively exercised.

### 2. Pre-judge gate precheck (#14678)
`decideProactiveComment` now runs `gate.wouldAdmit` (cap / global + per-surface cooldown — the text-independent rules) **before** the judge and short-circuits a denial, so a cooldown-suppressed switch spends **zero** model calls and never reaches `tryAdmit`. The fixture's `ObservedGate` only recorded `tryAdmit`, so the `s2`/`s7` suppressions were never captured (`gateDecisions.at(-1)` was stale → reason read `"ok"`), and their "still consulted the judge" assertions were wrong.

- Broke: `s2`/`s7: gate recorded the suppression reason (ok)`.
- Fix: `ObservedGate` also records `wouldAdmit` precheck **denials**; `s2`/`s7` now assert the judge is **skipped pre-judge** (proving the #14678 token-leak fix) and the precheck records `global cooldown` / `per-surface cooldown`. `judgeCalls` expectations + scripted `judgeOutputs` reduced to the 3 interactions that actually reach the judge (s1, s6, s9).

## Determination

Contract **drift**, not regression. No assertion weakened — the suite still verifies judge-routing + cooldown/dedup governance, now **more precisely**: it proves the #14678 optimization (cooldown-suppressed switches cost no model call) and the #14873 voice gate (comment preserved verbatim through delivery).

## Verification

- Suite **green 3× locally** at rebased tip (`origin/develop` @ 28d71d7d931).
- Gate ledger now records all 5 governance decisions:
  ```
  t+  1.6s ADMIT    [wallet] ok
  t+  3.2s SUPPRESS [calendar] global cooldown
  t+131.6s ADMIT    [shortcut:open-command-palette] ok
  t+261.6s SUPPRESS [wallet] per-surface cooldown
  t+761.6s SUPPRESS [shortcut:open-command-palette] duplicate of a recent comment
  ```
- Regenerated tracked evidence: `phase1-pipeline.json` now shows parsed comments + `judgeCalls:3`; screenshots show correct bubble text.
- `bun run audit:error-policy-ratchet`: clean (0 production source files touched — fixture-only change). Biome ignores the `.mjs` fixture path.

topPRs.title: feat(ui): unified liquid-glass system — tokens, GlassSurface, native iOS 26 GlassBridge, glass + menu
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
# Relates to

Unified glassmorphic / liquid-glass look across the shell (chat, notifications,
menus, buttons) with REAL system glass on iOS 26 and graceful fallback
everywhere else. Design doc:
`packages/docs/ongoing-development/liquid-glass-unification.md`.

- [x] Based on the notification-shade branch tip (stacks on #15217).
- [x] 8 contract tests + full chat-sheet e2e PASS on the branch.

# Risks

Medium-low. The only live visual change is the chat + menu (flat card → glass
menu variant); everything else is additive library surface. The Swift plugin is
compile- and availability-gated to iOS 26 — on every current device/SDK it
reports unavailable and nothing changes.

# Background

## What does this PR do?

1. **`packages/ui/src/glass/`** — the glass system: five role-based variants
   (`sheet`/`card`/`pill`/`menu`/`banner`) in `tokens.ts` consolidating the ten
   divergent surface recipes found in the shell audit; `GlassSurface` primitive
   + `GlassStyles` (one stylesheet + refraction defs per document, mounted at
   the App root); `useNativeGlass` tier probe (`ios26-native` →
   `css-refraction` → `css-frosted`); exported through the `@elizaos/ui`
   barrel with NO static `@capacitor/core` import (server-safe, #15221).
2. **`GlassBridge` Capacitor plugin** (Swift + TS): real
   `UIVisualEffectView(UIGlassEffect)` anchored below a transparent webview at
   web-reported rects. `#if compiler(>=6.2)` + `if #available(iOS 26,*)` gates;
   typechecked against the real iOS 26 SDK on this machine. Registration
   mirrors `ElizaKeyboardBridge`. Capacitor stays on 8 stable — 9.0.0-alpha.5
   ships nothing glass-related (release notes quoted in the design doc).
3. **First migration**: the chat composer **+ menu** renders on the glass
   `menu` variant via a new `glass` prop on `DropdownMenuContent`.
4. Chat-sheet e2e extended: asserts `.eliza-glass-menu` is live and snapshots
   the open menu.

## What kind of change is this?

Feature (design-system foundation) + one visual migration.

# Testing

## Where should a reviewer start?

`packages/ui/src/glass/tokens.ts` (the vocabulary), then `GlassSurface.tsx`,
then `GlassBridge.swift`.

## Detailed testing steps

```bash
bun run --cwd packages/ui test -- --run src/glass/glass.test.tsx   # 8 tests
bun packages/ui/src/components/shell/__e2e__/run-chat-sheet-e2e.mjs # full suite + glass assertion
```
